recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓顆粒富含細胞，其中散布許多明顯較大、深染的圓形巨核細胞，數量比預期多，這是 ITP 骨髓中巨核細胞增加的表現；低倍無法評估其成熟度。
features: Low-power view of cellular marrow particles with interspersed fat spaces
Numerous large, round, darker cells scattered within and around the particles, consistent with megakaryocytes
Megakaryocyte number appears increased for the particle area, without tight clustering
Dense background of smaller hematopoietic cells spread around the particles
Cytologic detail of megakaryocyte maturation cannot be assessed at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate shows cellular particles with interspersed fat spaces and abundant trail cellularity. Megakaryocytes are readily identified as numerous large dark cells scattered through the particles and appear increased in number. Individual megakaryocyte morphology cannot be evaluated at this magnification. In a patient with isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with the increased megakaryocytes typical of immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: MPNs show increased megakaryocytes that are large and hyperlobated (ET) or form tight atypical clusters (PMF), usually with thrombocytosis rather than thrombocytopenia.
MDS may have normal or increased megakaryocytes but with dysplastic hypolobated or separated-lobe forms and dysplasia in other lineages, which requires high-power review.

ddx.dx: Hypersplenism or consumptive thrombocytopenia (e.g. DIC, TTP)
ddx.vs: These also show increased megakaryocytes with peripheral destruction, so separation from ITP relies on clinical findings, splenomegaly, schistocytes and coagulation studies.
